name: Dockge Agent Display name
NoNetworksAvailable: No networks available. You need to add internal networks or enable external networks in the right side first.
ConsoleNotEnabledMSG1: Console is a powerful tool that allows you to execute any commands such as {docker}, {rm} within the Dockge's container in this Web UI.
ConsoleNotEnabledMSG2: It might be dangerous since this Dockge container is connecting to the host's Docker daemon. Also Dockge could be possibly taken down by commands like {rmRf}
ConsoleNotEnabledMSG3: If you understand the risk, you can enable it by setting {envVar} in the environment variables.
consoleDisabledHint: The console runs commands inside the Dockge container, which talks to the host Docker daemon, so it is off by default. It is turned on by DOCKGE_ENABLE_CONSOLE=true in the server environment.
confirmLeaveStack: You are currently editing a stack. Are you sure you want to leave?
composeFileHint: Every docker compose command of this stack points at this file.
needsComposeSelection: This directory holds several compose files. Pick the one Dockge should use.
envFilesHint: Passed to compose as --env-file in this order, later files override earlier ones. This is not the same as env_file inside a service.
noEnvFiles: This directory has no env file yet.
activeEnvFileHint: The editor below shows and saves this file.
secretsHint: Secrets are plain files of the stack directory, stored with 0600 permissions. A bound secret becomes available to the container at /run/secrets/ plus its name. Reading or changing a secret asks for your password.
secretPasswordHint: Reading and changing secrets is a separate action, so it needs your current password.
textModeOnly: This file uses {0}, which the structured editor cannot rewrite without changing its meaning. Edit it as text instead.
clipboardDenied: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard. Use Ctrl+V, Ctrl+Shift+V or Cmd+V instead.
multilinePasteTruncated: Only the first line was pasted: this console edits one command at a time.
reloadNeededAfterFileChange: The file selection was saved. Save or discard your edits, then reload the stack to see the newly selected files.
backupCodesHint: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once and they are shown only now.
twoFAVerifyLabel: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish
confirmEnableTwoFAMsg: Turn on two factor authentication? Every sign-in will then ask for a code.
confirmDisableTwoFAMsg: Turn off two factor authentication? The password alone will open a session again.
authInvalidCredentials: The email or the password is wrong.
authInvalidEmail: That is not a valid email address.
authPasswordTooShort: The password is too short, use at least 10 characters.
authAccountExists: This instance already has an account.
authInvalidBackupCode: The backup code was not accepted.
authTwoFactorNotEnabled: Two factor authentication is not enabled.
authTooManyRequests: Too many attempts, wait a minute and try again.
reconnectFailed: Signed in, but the connection to the server was lost. Reload the page.
twoFactorCodeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
tooManyPasswordAttempts: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.

validatedBeforeStart: The configuration is checked before anything starts
deployNeedsContentAndName: The buttons switch on once there is content and a name
deployOutputInTerminal: The output of the command is in the stack terminal.
flagsAllCarried: {count} flag carried over | all {count} flags carried over

flagRmDropped: compose keeps the container: remove it yourself when done
flagUnknown: unknown flag: check whether it survived
